usedFor: Airtable holds your product list and Ecwid runs the store, so “Create Product” adds each Airtable record to the shop.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Product” in Ecwid
bestTemplate.why: A product you add to a base shows up in the store without retyping its details.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” also fires on edits, so “Create Product” can add the same product twice.
